cai_paper.finding: Physical observation noise variance delta_0^2 is supplied as an input. Algorithm 2 does not learn that variance; TMP pseudo-observation and posterior variances are different quantities.

recommendation.estimator: Existing observation-only spatial covariance and Wax-Kailath MDL front end
recommendation.location: Section II-A, equations (5)-(7) and tail means, journal pages 2626-2627
recommendation.estimate: Mean of covariance eigenvalues after the MDL-selected spatial signal rank
recommendation.scope: Estimate once per received observation; retain frozen weights, thresholds, damping, stopping, and TMP variance updates. This is a project adaptation, not a Cai noise-estimation step.
recommendation.assumptions: Spatially white noise and a signal spatial covariance with rank below the number of antennas; correlated snapshots and model mismatch limit theoretical guarantees.

evidence_scope: Existing baseline panel diagnostics only; no Proposed estimated-noise inference has been run. Mean ratios are not per-scene error bounds.
next_validation: Use prior development scenes to check public inputs, scaling and end-to-end inference before the paired 6000-inference experiment. Do not tune on the formal 1000-scene panel.
